locations.name: Swayambhunath Stupa (Monkey Temple)
locations.description: One of Nepal's oldest and most sacred Buddhist stupas, situated on a hilltop overlooking Kathmandu Valley. Famous for its white dome, golden spire, and resident monkeys.

locations.name: Pashupatinath Temple
locations.description: Nepal's most important Hindu temple dedicated to Lord Shiva. Located on the banks of the Bagmati River and a UNESCO World Heritage Site.

locations.name: Boudhanath Stupa
locations.description: One of the largest spherical stupas in the world and the centre of Tibetan Buddhism in Nepal.

locations.name: Phewa Lake
locations.description: Pokhara's iconic lake offering boating, lakeside dining, and reflections of the Annapurna mountain range.

locations.name: World Peace Pagoda
locations.description: A beautiful white Buddhist stupa located on a hilltop with panoramic views of Pokhara, Phewa Lake, and the Himalayas.

locations.name: Davis Falls
locations.description: A unique waterfall where water disappears into an underground tunnel. One of Pokhara's most visited attractions.

locations.name: Chitwan National Park
locations.description: Nepal's first national park and a UNESCO World Heritage Site, famous for jungle safaris, one-horned rhinoceroses, elephants, and Bengal tigers.

locations.name: Elephant Breeding Center
locations.description: A conservation and breeding facility where visitors can learn about Asian elephants and their care.

locations.name: Rapti River Sunset Point
locations.description: Popular location for sunset viewing, canoe rides, birdwatching, and experiencing Chitwan's natural beauty.

locations.name: Maya Devi Temple
locations.description: The exact birthplace of Lord Buddha and the most sacred site in Lumbini.

locations.name: Lumbini Sacred Garden
locations.description: A peaceful pilgrimage area containing monasteries, meditation zones, and historical Buddhist monuments.

locations.name: World Peace Pagoda (Lumbini)
locations.description: A striking white pagoda symbolising global peace and harmony.

locations.name: Bhaktapur Durbar Square
locations.description: A UNESCO World Heritage Site featuring medieval palaces, temples, courtyards, and traditional Newari architecture.

locations.name: Nyatapola Temple
locations.description: Nepal's tallest pagoda-style temple, renowned for its impressive five-tier architecture.

locations.name: 55-Window Palace
locations.description: A masterpiece of traditional wood craftsmanship located within Bhaktapur Durbar Square.

locations.name: Swayambhu Mahachaitya
locations.description: A hilltop sacred site anchored by a majestic white stupa painted with the Buddha's watchful eyes, surrounded by ancient shrines, prayer wheels, and resident holy monkeys.

locations.name: Nagarkot Sunrise View Park
locations.description: A high-altitude scenic viewpoint offering sweeping panoramas of major Himalayan peaks including Mount Everest on clear days, along with breathtaking sunrise and sunset views over the valley.

locations.name: Muktinath Temple, Nepal
locations.description: A revered mountain sanctuary featuring a central pagoda dedicated to Vishnu, surrounded by 108 sacred outdoor water spouts and natural gas fires burning alongside underground streams.

locations.name: Namche Bazar
locations.description: A vibrant mountain town carved into a steep amphitheater-shaped hillside, lined with traditional Sherpa bakeries, outdoor equipment shops, cafes, and dramatic views of nearby snow-capped peaks.

locations.name: Bandipur
locations.description: A pedestrianized hilltop village with preserved 18th-century wooden townhouses, traditional stone-paved bazaar streets, and scenic overlooks facing the Annapurna mountain range.

locations.name: Janaki Temple
locations.description: A magnificent 19th-century white temple built in an ornate Hindu-Islamic Mughal architectural style, featuring double-arched domes, stained glass windows, and grand courtyard shrines.

locations.name: Gosaikunda Lake
locations.description: A sacred high-altitude mountain lake surrounded by rugged alpine peaks, attracting both mountain trekkers and thousands of pilgrims during the Janai Purnima festival.
